description.html: With a 60x50 cm base and a height of 90 cm, this terrarium holds 270 liters. Its half meter of depth is what distinguishes it from the 60x40x90 model: even with the 3D background there is enough room left for dense plants and branches in several rows.

For a veiled chameleon or a panther chameleon, the 50 cm depth lets it hide behind leaves, which reduces its stress. Arboreal snakes get branches placed both lengthwise and across the depth. A pair of crested geckos has enough space for each to find its own sleeping spot. Larger tree frogs do well with the wide, damp floor.

items: Crested geckos kept as a pair

description.html: A terrarium this tall stands on the floor or on a low stand, so also measure the ceiling height above the lamp. State the species you keep, so that we can place the mesh vents to suit it. We ship by courier, and the build time is 7 to 14 days. You choose the background relief between rock and bark.
